shortDescription: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. said global refining is tightening because of wars in the Middle East and between Moscow and Kyiv, and more than doubled its forecast for profits from making diesel, according to Bloomberg.

title: Goldman More Than Doubles Diesel Profit Forecast on War-Driven Refining Tightness
